title: Commit: feat(arch): L0 Hardware & Compute layer detail per owner specification
content:
feat(arch): L0 Hardware & Compute layer detail per owner specification

Implements the owner's L0 Sollstruktur (2026-10-15):

- L0 expanded from 6 draft sub-layers to the 9 owner-specified
  sub-layers (L0.1 CPU through L0.9 Hardware Identity & Capability
  Discovery), with architecture_id ATC-LAYER-L0-HARDWARE-COMPUTE
- 35 proposed function contracts (ATC-L0-CPU-001 ... ATC-L0-DISC-004)
  generated as machine-readable catalog with binding metadata schema:
  identity, hierarchy, contract (inputs/outputs/errors/pre/post),
  hardware, security (trust boundary, provenance, trust level),
  SSOT, verification, status
- All 35 functions start as UNRESOLVED (Sollstruktur contracts,
  not existing implementations) with documented status_reason
- Layer dependency matrix: 9 contracts covering L1/L2/L3/L4/L5/L6/
  L7/L8/L10 required L0 capabilities
- 7 acceptance criteria encoded as machine-readable list
- Capability-not-permission principle added to registry and catalog:
  L0 provides capabilities, grants no permissions; device access,
  DMA, memory isolation enforcement lives in L1/L2/X1
- Sub-layer ID format normalized to dot notation (L0.1, L2.4, X1.1)
  across registry, doc, and catalog hierarchy definition
- Registry components list fixed: L0 now includes COMP-COMPUTE
  (was empty, inconsistent with layer mapping)
- Validator extended with stage 4 (L0 catalog): unique IDs, required
  fields, registry cross-check of sub-layers, status value binding,
  VERIFIED-requires-evidence rule, dependency target validation
